source_review.notes: Checked ACM-linked, CMU, IEEE-linked, SIAM, author, and official MPI Forum records for parallel-prefix circuits, Hillis-Steele and Blelloch scan, prefix-network trade-offs, reproducible summation, floating-point analysis, and MPI 4.1 collective semantics. Version-sensitive MPI behavior is explicitly tied to Version 4.1, approved November 2, 2023.

evidence: Checked reduction, inclusive and exclusive scan, monoid, ordered fold, work, span, interval, communication, and segment-head notation before use.
Checked operation domains, identity sides, ordering, represented arithmetic, half-open intervals, and balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Mathematical associativity, represented-machine behavior, reproducibility, and empirical performance remain distinct claims.

evidence: Recomputed all reduction, exclusive-scan, inclusive-scan, segmented-scan, compaction, prefix-depth, work, span, communication, and overflow examples.
Exhaustively compared the work-efficient scan with sequential addition and ordered string-concatenation oracles over 556 binary inputs of lengths 1, 2, 4, and 8.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The bounded enumeration checked exact results, reduction totals, combine counts, and level depths; hypothetical communication costs are declared model inputs.

evidence: Re-derived balanced-reduction n-1 work and logarithmic span, Blelloch 2n-2 combine count and two-logarithm span, and Hillis-Steele logarithmic span with n-logarithm work.
Re-derived exclusive-to-inclusive conversion, hierarchical block decomposition, compaction destinations, and segmented-operator cases.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Asymptotic statements remain conditional on the declared unit-cost and synchronization models.

evidence: Checked empty and singleton inputs, non-power lengths, invalid padding, missing identities, nonassociative operators, associative noncommutative operators, consecutive segment heads, and empty partitions.

Checked operand reversal, mixed dependency levels, aliasing, overflow, floating cancellation, NaN and infinity policy, overlapping shards, incompatible collectives, failed participants, and membership changes.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: A valid mathematical tree is not treated as evidence for safe memory behavior, failure recovery, or acceptable floating semantics.

evidence: Checked that each upsweep node represents exactly one contiguous ordered interval and each downsweep node receives exactly the prefix before its interval.
All 556 enumerated scans preserved order, exact input coverage, identity placement, total reduction, 2n-2 combine count, and 2 log2 n basic level depth.
invariant_checking.notes: Hierarchical and distributed correctness additionally require disjoint membership, consistent rank order, and completed synchronization edges.

evidence: Reviewed the bottom-up interval-total induction and top-down incoming-prefix induction through leaf exclusive prefixes.
Reviewed associativity versus commutativity, segmented-operator head cases, balanced-tree operation sums, and hierarchical prefix decomposition.
proof_review.notes: The executable is a sequential reference for the dependency graph; it does not prove a concurrent runtime or distributed collective implementation.

evidence: Audited proof, induction, invariant, model, asymptotic, simplified, exact, reproducible, ordered, and empirical language.
Separated algebraic equivalence, machine arithmetic, abstract work/span, synchronization mechanism, communication model, and production policy.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No simplified alpha-beta formula or abstract tree depth is presented as an exact wall-clock guarantee.

evidence: The CPython 3.14.4 snippet exited zero with exact exclusive and inclusive outputs, reduction 25, 14 combines, six levels, and ordered string prefixes on macOS 13.7.8 x86_64.
Independent exhaustive checks covered 556 addition and ordered-string inputs plus the complete exercise trace.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution supports the bounded reference algorithm only; it does not establish race freedom, MPI behavior, numerical accuracy in general, hardware efficiency, fault tolerance, or production scalability.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed algebraic requirements, sequential baselines, balanced reduction, Hillis-Steele, work-efficient upsweep/downsweep, segmented and hierarchical scans, collectives, numerical semantics, synchronization, and validation.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed padding, indexing, aliasing, barriers, task dependences, false sharing, GPU synchronization, block and rank order, overflow, reproducibility, collective membership, process failure, observability, and safe failure behavior.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter derives work and span, executes an order-preserving generic scan, proves interval invariants, contrasts circuit and machine designs, supplies ten distinct examples, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, parallel-algorithm, numerical-analysis, MPI, hardware, GPU, operating-system, compiler, performance, or operational review is claimed. Conclusions remain conditional on algebra, represented numeric domain, identity, order, input coverage, memory model, synchronization, topology, collective membership, failure policy, implementation, toolchain, machine, and measurement assumptions.
